Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE IV OF 2001
BANK OF PUNJAB
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE IV OF, 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 23rd May, 2001]
No. Legis.3(IV)/2001, dated
23-5-2001.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and
commencement.--(1) This Ordinance may be called the Bank of Punjab
(Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Amendment of section 4 of Act XII of 1989

ORDINANCE IV OF 2001
BANK OF PUNJAB
(AMENDMENT) ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE IV OF, 2001
An Ordinance
further to amend the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989
[Gazette of Punjab,
Extraordinary, 23rd May, 2001]
No. Legis.3(IV)/2001, dated
23-5-2001.--The following Ordinance promulgated by the Governor of the
Punjab is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 4 of
Act XII of 1989.--In the Bank of Punjab Act, 1989 (XII of 1989), in section
4, in subsection (1) for the words "one thousand million rupees divided into
one hundred million ordinary shares", the words "two thousand
millions rupees divided into two hundred million ordinary shares" shall be
substituted.
